name: Netherlands
summary: Low-lying North Sea delta nation renowned for hydraulic engineering, intensive agricultural greenhouse horticulture, and rapid expansion of North Sea offshore wind complexes.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.96x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); dense livestock agriculture generates elevated ammonia and secondary aerosol precursors.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; KNMI recorded warmest calendar year in 300-year observational series.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across Dutch delta stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.3% share of global emissions; closure of Groningen gas field shifts supply to LNG imports.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Elevated per capita emissions from major Rotterdam refining petrochemical clusters and intensive greenhouse heating.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Intensively managed agricultural landscape; woodland coverage ~3,800 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Rapid transition: offshore and onshore wind (27.2%) and rooftop/utility solar PV (17.3%) provide nearly half of power.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: High population density of 526 people/km²; urban population fraction is 92.8%.
